blocks.text: An as-of join accepts a version only when both event time and availability time precede the cutoff. The task is: As-of feature-join reference. Requests are (entity,cutoff); versions are dicts with entity,event_time,available_time,version,value. Select the greatest (event_time,available_time,version) eligible tuple where BOTH timestamps <=cutoff. Return selected row copies or None in request order. This O(R*V) core prioritizes the temporal contract.

The inputs are `requests`, `versions`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
